name: Music
goalName: Figure out what the best music genre is for a sensitive game with a target group having a tough time
goal: Kind Regards, will be played by young children, who are going through a rough period in their lives. To make sure the game does not feel too empty, it is a good idea to add background music. However, I need to be careful when selecting music, as different styles of music have different effects on people's mood.

normalLearnings: I know which music is allowed to use in a game without getting copyright strikes
specialLearnings: I know how to apply the principles of music therapy through the music of a game
result: Although the principles of music therapy could not be applied to the game, I was able to give insights to my group to select music for the game. Research showed that calm and relaxing music works best for this game.
validation: I verified my expectations and result with an expert and am currently setting up focus group research and playtests to see the actual results rather than a hypothesis.
contribution: This directly contributes to the game. Next, my teammates and I are conducting the research. For my own game, I might be able to implement the principles of music therapy, if the game's aesthetics allow it.
